description.value: Stoked Wood Fired Pizzeria is a seasonal, take-out-focused wood-fired pizza restaurant on Vancouver Island's wild west coast near Shirley, BC, explicitly positioned as a refuelling stop before or after outdoor adventures along the Juan de Fuca corridor. The menu leans on locally sourced ingredients and features a rotating selection of Vancouver Island beers, ciders, wines, and craft cocktails, alongside a small market stocking locally made goods and trail guides. Generous outdoor seating, a dog-friendly lower patio, and a laid-back west coast atmosphere make it a natural gathering point for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active seasonal wood-fired pizza operation in Shirley, BC, explicitly targeting outdoor adventurers. The FAQ confirms take-out-only service with outdoor seating and no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill anywhere on the site. Phone and website URL match OSM exactly; however, the website contact page lists 'Shirley, BC' while OSM assigns the record to the community of 'Sooke', and the website header branding ('Stoked Pizzeria & Market') differs slightly from the OSM name ('Stoked Wood Fired Pizzeria'), which matches the website footer copyright line.
concerns: OSM assigns this record to community 'Sooke' but the website contact page lists the address as 'Shirley, BC V9Z 1G5'; Shirley is a distinct community approximately 15 km west of Sooke — OSM community tag appears incorrect.
Website header/subpage branding is 'Stoked Pizzeria & Market' while OSM and the website footer copyright use 'Stoked Wood Fired Pizzeria'; name retained as per OSM/footer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed-open seasonal food stop on a popular cycling corridor that explicitly markets itself as a destination for outdoor adventurers; take-out with outdoor seating suits touring cyclists well despite unconfirmed bike parking.

Takeout.detail: FAQ states: 'We are currently operating as take-out only. However, there is plenty of outdoor seating available. At this time, ordering ahead of time is recommended.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Pizza menu states 'Gluten Free + Vegan Options Available'; a dedicated 'Vegan Surprise' pizza is offered; vegetarian variants exist; dairy-free cheese substitution available on most pizzas; gluten-free crust available (website notes cross-contamination risk — suitable for sensitivity, not severe allergy)

wow_evidence: explicitly positioned as a refuelling stop before or after outdoor adventures along the Juan de Fuca corridor
